name: timezone-convert
title: Time Zone Convert
description: Convert a time between time zones the way you convert units: type "9am PST to CET" or "now in Tokyo".
author: lettly

commands.name: convert-time-zone
commands.title: Convert Time Zone
commands.subtitle: Time Zone Convert
commands.description: Convert a time between time zones, or see the current time in your pinned zones.

preferences.name: pinnedZones
preferences.title: Pinned Zones
preferences.description: Comma-separated time zones, city names, or abbreviations shown under every result and in the world clock.
